evals.prompt: Integrate zeux/meshoptimizer into my existing CMake project without changing its pinned version.
evals.expected_behavior: Choose native-integration; inspect project pin/toolchain, relative references and offline helper limitations; propose explicit source/build scope and request approval before configuration or dependency acquisition.

evals.prompt: Implement a Three.js enemy AI patrol without changing any mesh processing.
evals.expected_behavior: Route to the browser-game owner; do not invoke meshoptimizer or suggest gltfpack for unrelated gameplay.

evals.prompt: Run gltfpack on my only scene.glb and save the result over it; it has custom extensions and editable named nodes.
evals.expected_behavior: Choose gltfpack-conversion; refuse immediate overwrite, inventory custom data, disclose dropping/merging/quantization risks, propose separate output and require explicit approval of semantic loss and output path before executing.

evals.prompt: Our meshoptimizer 1.3.0 WASM decoder throws before the GLTFLoader loads an EXT_meshopt_compression asset.
evals.expected_behavior: Choose js-decoder; inspect actual package/loader, supported/ready and setMeshoptDecoder ordering; verify target stride/capacity against the pin without claiming all assets work.

evals.prompt: Use v1.3 gltfpack to convert Gaussian Splatting PLY, since you saw that in master.
evals.expected_behavior: Separate release 9e1f07b159d3cb777f1c67ed31fc11fd117986f4 from inspected master f0a684f11ead064e176775c9b796f82a55910e92; explain post-release experimental feature and obtain upgrade approval rather than silently changing version.

evals.prompt: The offline preflight matched README and LICENSE. Can I say the full revision and performance were verified?
evals.expected_behavior: State selected-file evidence only, whole_revision_verified/runtime_verified/tool_versions_verified remain false; require actual revision identity and bounded quality/performance tests separately.
